quests.name: Short on Raw Lobster
quests.summary: The banker of Varenhollow has run out of raw lobster.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 21 raw lobster and nobody in Varenhollow has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Fishing Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Varenhollow to the fishing shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the fishing shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the general store keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Magic Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the magic shop keeper of Varenhollow and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the magic shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The barber sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Varenhollow Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Varenhollow Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Varenhollow Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Giant Spiders
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper wants the giant spider near Varenhollow thinned out.
intro: The giant spider beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 13 of them close to Varenhollow and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Bones
quests.summary: The magic shop keeper of Varenhollow has run out of bones.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 16 bones and nobody in Varenhollow has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

intro: This should have gone to the general store keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the clothes shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Fishing Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the fishing shop keeper of Varenhollow and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the fishing shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The food shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.

quests.name: Supply Run to Seluford
quests.summary: Gather maple logs for the banker, then carry a shipment to Seluford.
intro: I have an order from Seluford and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 26 maple logs, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the banker in Varenhollow.
From Varenhollow? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Varenhollow and bring back mithril ore.
intro: The wilds around Varenhollow need a firm hand. Start with 13 snake outside the walls, then 21 spider down in Varenhollow Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 21 mithril ore to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Varenhollow for the barber.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the sword shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The barber asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the realtor does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the sword shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Varenhollow Sewers
quests.summary: Clear spider out of Varenhollow Sewers and tell the archery shop keeper.
intro: Varenhollow Sewers is crawling with spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 21 of them, then let the archery shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Varenhollow owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Varenhollow Sewers is clearer than it was. 21 spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Seluford (Archery Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Gather willow logs for the archery shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Seluford.
intro: I have an order from Seluford and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 26 willow logs, then take the packed shipment to the archery shop keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the archery shop keeper in Varenhollow.

quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Varenhollow and bring back big bones.

When that is done, bring me 16 big bones to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: The Varenhollow Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Varenhollow and Seluford.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Seluford. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 31 snake near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the general store keeper in Varenhollow.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Seluford is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Varenhollow has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Varenhollow
quests.summary: Find what rules Varenhollow Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Ooze Mother.
intro: Something rules Varenhollow Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the magic shop keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Varenhollow is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Ooze Mother.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Ooze Mother is dead. Varenhollow Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Frostbite Cavern, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Frostbite Cavern has stood against Varenhollow for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the clothes shop keeper, fight your way through 31 spider and end The Broodmother.
Bring 21 raw salmon back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Frostbite Cavern?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Varenhollow: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.
